description: Service configuration template for cross-platform integrations. Copy this file to services.json and populate with actual values. NEVER commit services.json with real secrets.

openai.notes: Set OPENAI_API_KEY in environment or GitHub secrets

manychat.notes: Set MANYCHAT_API_KEY in environment or GitHub secrets

botbuilders.description: BotBuilders API for bot development platform
botbuilders.notes: Set BOTBUILDERS_API_KEY in environment or GitHub secrets. Optionally override baseUrl with SERVICE_BASE_URL_BOTBUILDERS

moltbook.notes: Set MOLTBOOK_API_KEY in environment or GitHub secrets. Optionally override baseUrl with SERVICE_BASE_URL_MOLTBOOK

moltbot.notes: Set MOLTBOT_API_KEY in environment or GitHub secrets. Optionally override baseUrl with SERVICE_BASE_URL_MOLTBOT

openclaw.notes: Set OPENCLAW_API_KEY in environment or GitHub secrets. Optionally override baseUrl with SERVICE_BASE_URL_OPENCLAW (default: https://api.openclaw.com)

github.description: GitHub API for extended operations beyond current repository
github.notes: GITHUB_PAT is only needed for API calls beyond the current repository. Repository operations use GITHUB_TOKEN automatically.

webhooks.description: Generic webhook endpoint for notifications and integrations
webhooks.notes: Set WEBHOOK_URL in environment or GitHub secrets for webhook notifications

envVarReference.description: Reference guide for all environment variables used in service integrations

GITHUB_PAT.description: Personal Access Token for GitHub API (only if extended access needed beyond current repo)

SERVICE_BASE_URL_OPENCLAW.description: Base URL for OpenClaw API (overrides default)

SERVICE_BASE_URL_BOTBUILDERS.description: Base URL for BotBuilders API (overrides default)

SERVICE_BASE_URL_MOLTBOOK.description: Base URL for Moltbook API (overrides default)

SERVICE_BASE_URL_MOLTBOT.description: Base URL for Moltbot API (overrides default)

usage.description: How to use this configuration file
steps: 1. Copy this file to services.json: cp config/services.example.json config/services.json
2. Set environment variables or GitHub secrets for the services you want to use
3. Update services.json to enable specific services (set 'enabled': true)
4. NEVER commit services.json with real API keys or secrets
5. Add config/services.json to .gitignore if not already present

githubSecrets.description: To use in GitHub Actions, add secrets in repository settings
githubSecrets.location: Repository Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret
githubSecrets.workflowUsage: The integrations.yml workflow automatically checks for these secrets

localDevelopment.description: For local development, use environment variables or a .env file

warnings: ⚠️  NEVER commit real API keys or secrets to version control
⚠️  Always use environment variables or secret management systems
⚠️  Rotate keys immediately if accidentally committed
⚠️  Use GitHub's secret scanning to detect leaked credentials
⚠️  Limit API key permissions to minimum required scope
bestPractices: ✓ Use separate API keys for development, staging, and production
✓ Regularly rotate API keys and secrets
✓ Monitor API usage for unusual activity
✓ Use GitHub's Dependabot for security updates
